captures.note: Direct download, NOT a YouTube re-encode, so the sha256 will be a real identity rather than a record of what yt-dlp happened to pick that day. 640x480 H.264 + FLAC. Two properties make it unusually good ground truth for this production. (1) FLAC is lossless: alignment here is by audio cross-correlation, and the softsynth's output can be regenerated byte-exactly by work/re/runsynth.py, so the correlation is between two clean signals rather than against a lossy re-encode of a guess. (2) 640x480 matches the __640/__480 constants sitting in the binary's float pool, which suggests a native-resolution capture rather than a rescale. Fetch and pin locally: this host is not reachable from a cloud session (403 at the egress proxy), see docs/CLOUD_ENVIRONMENT.md. Capture is recorded, never distributed - work/reference/ is gitignored.
